name: chefrail
display_name: ChefRail (two arms on a ceiling rail)
task: Two arms on a ceiling rail over the kitchen cook simple one-pot recipes, serve them on the island and load the dishwasher afterwards.

trigger.label: Cook dinner
options: Recipe: chicken stir-fry / veggie pasta / omelette

bom_assumptions: Quantity-1 2026 prices. Arms: 2 x 6-DOF, 1.4 m reach, 3 kg payload (a pot of water), built from quasi-direct-drive actuators (~$5,000 each). Ceiling rail: 4.2 m motorised linear track + carriage + joist mounting (~$2,000). Vision + compute: ceiling RGB-D camera, 2 wrist cameras, Jetson AGX Orin (~$2,500). Tool changer + dicer + spoon/ladle/tongs (~$1,500). 2 parallel grippers (~$1,600). Safety light curtain + e-stop (~$500). Wall-powered; height_m is how far the folded arms hang below the ceiling.
cost_drivers: 2 x 6-DOF arms, 1.4 m reach, 3 kg payload
Vision + compute: ceiling + wrist cameras, Jetson AGX Orin
4.2 m motorised ceiling rail, carriage and mounting
env_changes_required: Ceiling rail screwed into joists along the kitchen at 2.15 m (needs a joist run parallel to the counters; ~1 day install).
Open shelf for bowls/plates at the west end of the counter, within reach of the rail (~$80); cabinet doors are not opened.
Cutting board and a lever dicer kept on the north edge of the island as the prep zone.
Stove safety shutoff that cuts the burners if the robot or the user walks away (~$150); the robot turns the knobs itself.
Pantry staples in labelled bins on one fridge shelf so the arms can find them.
tasks_excluded: Freehand knife work: cutting irregular produce next to people is high-risk; it uses a mounted dicer, pre-cut or frozen ingredients instead.
Tasting and seasoning by taste: no reliable sensor; it follows the recipe amounts.
Serving at the dining table: the rail doesn't reach it; food is served on the island and the user carries it.
Hand-washing pans and putting dishes away in cabinets: everything goes in the dishwasher's top rack; unloading is left to the user.
Oven roasting with heavy dishes (>3 kg) and deep frying: payload and spill risk.
Starting on its own: on-demand only, from the phone button.
